001-kind-turn-end.json.note: A turn-end moment with only the fields that kind requires.

002-kind-needs-you.json.note: A needs-you moment with only the fields that kind requires.

003-kind-answered.json.note: A answered moment with only the fields that kind requires.

004-kind-error.json.note: A error moment with only the fields that kind requires.

005-kind-recovered.json.note: A recovered moment with only the fields that kind requires.

006-kind-limit-hit.json.note: A limit-hit moment with only the fields that kind requires.

007-kind-limit-reset.json.note: A limit-reset moment with only the fields that kind requires.

008-kind-weekly-reset.json.note: A weekly-reset moment with only the fields that kind requires.

009-turn-end-with-turn-ms.json.note: turn_end carries turn_ms so the long-turn notification can fire.

012-turn-ms-just-over-two-minutes.json.note: turn_ms just past the two minute long-turn threshold.

013-needs-you-permission.json.note: needs_you with reason permission from claude.

014-tool-claude-turn-end.json.note: A turn_end from the claude tool with its own agent id.

015-tool-codex-turn-end.json.note: A turn_end from the codex tool with its own agent id.

016-tool-opencode-turn-end.json.note: A turn_end from the opencode tool with its own agent id.

017-tool-antigravity-turn-end.json.note: A turn_end from the antigravity tool with its own agent id.

018-tool-gemini-turn-end.json.note: A turn_end from the gemini tool with its own agent id.

019-tool-cursor-turn-end.json.note: A turn_end from the cursor tool with its own agent id.

020-tool-aider-turn-end.json.note: A turn_end from the aider tool with its own agent id.

021-tool-other-turn-end.json.note: A turn_end from the other tool with its own agent id.

022-limit-hit-codex.json.note: limit_hit for provider codex with no agent or tool.

023-limit-hit-with-agent.json.note: limit_hit may name its agent and tool when the source knows them.

042-milestone-first-turn.json.note: The first-turn milestone as an island moment with no agent.

043-milestone-first-answer.json.note: The first-answer milestone as an island moment with no agent.

044-milestone-first-subagent.json.note: The first-subagent milestone as an island moment with no agent.

045-milestone-two-tools-day.json.note: The two-tools-day milestone as an island moment with no agent.

046-milestone-turns-100.json.note: The turns-100 milestone as an island moment with no agent.

047-milestone-streak-7.json.note: The streak-7 milestone as an island moment with no agent.

048-milestone-turns-1000.json.note: The turns-1000 milestone as an island moment with no agent.

049-turn-end-at-min-time.json.note: turn_end at the minimum legal timestamp.

050-turn-end-at-max-time.json.note: turn_end at the maximum legal timestamp.

051-build-complete-finished-stage-three..note: build_complete at stage 3, meaning the structure is finished.

052-milestone-at-min-time.json.note: A milestone at the minimum legal timestamp.

053-needs-you-with-request.json.note: needs_you keyed by its request id, so it notifies once per request.

054-question-with-request.json.note: A question alert keyed by its request id.

055-answered-with-request.json.note: answered names the request it closes, so its notification is withdrawn.

001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object, not an array.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object, not null.

003-root-string.json.note: The root must be an object, not a string.

008-schema-version-string.json.note: schema_version must be the integer 1, not a string.

009-kind-finished.json.note: finished is not a moment kind (it is a state transition elsewhere).

010-kind-hyphenated.json.note: Kinds use underscores, so turn-end is unknown.

011-t-in-seconds.json.note: t in seconds is below the millisecond range.

014-unknown-text-field.json.note: Moments carry no free text, so an unknown text field is rejected.

015-leaked-prompt.json.note: A raw prompt field is an unknown property and is rejected.

016-turn-end-missing-agent-and-tool.json.note: turn_end must name its agent and tool.

017-limit-hit-tool-without-agent.json.note: tool without agent is rejected by dependentRequired.

018-limit-hit-agent-without-tool.json.note: agent without tool is rejected by dependentRequired.

019-agent-raw-uuid.json.note: agent is a salted id, never a raw session UUID.

021-agent-null.json.note: agent is present as a string or absent, never null.

022-tool-unknown.json.note: tool must be one of the known tools.

023-tool-null.json.note: tool is present as a string or absent, never null.

024-agent-on-milestone.json.note: Island moments are not tied to an agent.

025-agent-on-build-complete.json.note: build_complete is an island moment and names no agent.

026-agent-on-limit-reset.json.note: limit_reset is an island moment and names no agent.

027-agent-on-weekly-reset.json.note: weekly_reset is an island moment and names no agent.

030-reason-null.json.note: reason is omitted when it does not apply, never null.

031-reason-on-turn-end.json.note: reason is only allowed on needs_you.

032-turn-ms-on-needs-you.json.note: turn_ms is only allowed on turn_end.

035-turn-ms-fraction.json.note: turn_ms must be an integer, not 1.5.

036-turn-ms-null.json.note: turn_ms is omitted when unknown, never null.

039-provider-on-turn-end.json.note: provider is only allowed on the limit kinds.

040-provider-unknown-limit-reset.json.note: provider must be claude or codex.

041-provider-null-limit-hit.json.note: provider is required and cannot be null.

044-structure-unknown.json.note: structure must be a known structure slot.

045-structure-null.json.note: structure cannot be null on build_complete.

046-structure-on-milestone.json.note: structure is only allowed on build_complete.

047-structure-on-turn-end.json.note: structure is only allowed on build_complete.

050-stage-null.json.note: stage cannot be null on build_complete.

051-stage-string.json.note: stage must be an integer, not a string.

052-stage-on-turn-end.json.note: stage is only allowed on build_complete.

053-milestone-missing.json.note: milestone kind requires a milestone id.

054-milestone-unknown.json.note: milestone must be one of the seven milestone ids.

055-milestone-null.json.note: milestone cannot be null on the milestone kind.

056-milestone-on-turn-end.json.note: milestone is only allowed on the milestone kind.

057-request-on-turn-end.json.note: request_id is only allowed on needs_you and answered.

058-request-on-error.json.note: request_id is only allowed on needs_you and answered.

059-request-on-limit-hit.json.note: request_id is only allowed on needs_you and answered.

060-request-null.json.note: request_id is omitted when unknown, never null.

061-request-raw-uuid.json.note: request_id is a salted hash, never a raw id.
